about: An own lot never forks a place's lock: accept tells each place the lines of the lot it takes and folds its lock with and without them, and a claim that would stand twice where it stood once refuses the lot whole, before anything is signed into a lock. A lot for many places lands the same lines at each; lines meant for one place go in a lot of their own.

cases.name: a lot on a copy at 299 telling bound's lock region/vocabulary twice (src/**/*.ts at one witness, src/**/*.mts at another)
this lot's own lines at bound: 8 withdraws and 8 region lines, one per claim

red was: a lot for eight places that landed every line at each
